definitions.collapse_scenario: scenario in which >= 90% of its 5 original datasets have k-hat_R = 2 (with n = 5 this means all 5)
definitions.collapse_dataset_strict: original dataset with k-hat_R = 2 AND k-hat_S = 2 in >= 90% of its 1000 synthetic draws
definitions._k>=3: same, restricted to planted k >= 3, where k-hat = 2 is an under-estimate
